card.name: Linking words before surgery terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as after, following or prior to, placed where the next word is likely surgery, resection or cystectomy. Seen in adjuvant cancer dosing text.

modes.label: After surgery
modes.description: The word after or following right after an adjuvant drug or at-risk patient phrase, before a surgery word.
modes.example: Adjuvant: IMFINZI 20 mg/kg every 4 weeks for up to 12 cycles as a single agent<< after>> surgery.

modes.label: Before surgery
modes.description: The words prior to or is, leading into surgery in neoadjuvant or treatment descriptions.
modes.example: oadjuvant : IMFINZI 1,500 mg in combination with chemotherapy every 3 weeks for up to 4 cycles prior<< to>> surgery.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict surgery and surgical words next.
card.plain: It fires on words like after or following when the next word is likely to be surgery.
